purpose: Define how cruise-mode advice_task events become AI-native coach outputs without requiring continuous chatter.
runtime_flow: scorer emits advice_task candidates and candidate actions
lifecycle merges, cools down, expires, confirms, skips, and returns modes to cruise
priority/confidence gate decides whether to request a host CLI main-model response
backend emits advice_response_requested with host_cli_agent_request; backend fallback text is not final user text
current CLI main model generates final Chinese coach text from the request
host response is merged back as coach_response/user_visible_text
user confirmation, skip, mode switch, or new evidence updates match context

speak_when: medium or higher value_score crossing the interrupt gate
active task mode asks for output
user message updates the active task
new evidence materially changes an active advice_task
do_not_speak_for: minor repeated shop changes inside cooldown
same trigger already active unless advice materially updates

machine_layer.purpose: Stable envelope for UI, CLI, voice, notifications, logs, tests, and future automation.
machine_layer.hard_rule: The machine layer keeps predictable fields and host_cli_agent_request; it must not be treated as the final player-facing answer.

rendering_layer.purpose: Final human-facing coach text generated by the current CLI main model from host_cli_agent_request.

applies_to: target lineup from live rankings or user target plan
transition lineup written by the agent
next-pivot lineup written by the agent
lineup_display_policy.host_model_rule: When lineup_board_text is present, the host CLI model embeds it verbatim and writes only the surrounding coaching text. It must not redraw the board manually.
lineup_display_policy.hook_role: Hooks/verifiers guard that lineup boards come from the mechanical renderer, not from hand-written model text.

examples: Example only: keep the strongest current direction, preserve interest if the risk is low, and ask the user to confirm missing manual scouting facts only when that missing fact changes the decision.
Example only: keep one augment as backup, reroll weaker slots first, then recompute from the latest visible three choices.

model_freedom: The agent may rewrite the final user-facing text naturally.
The agent may compress, combine, or omit low-value evidence.
The agent should not expose hidden chain-of-thought; show concise reasons and concrete actions.
The agent may ask for user confirmation when a missing current-match fact would change the decision; it must not request automatic opponent-board snapshots.
ai_native_output_policy.recommended_user_text_shape: one conclusion, one reason, one action; expand only when the user asks or the task mode requires detail

runtime_json_read_policy.reason: PowerShell console codepage/rendering can display valid UTF-8 JSON as mojibake. Chinese correctness must be judged from Node UTF-8 parsed values, not terminal rendering.
runtime_json_read_policy.hard_rule: Any verifier or hook that checks Chinese runtime/catalog data must read JSON through Node fs.readFile(..., 'utf8') plus JSON.parse. PowerShell Get-Content output is allowed for quick human inspection only, never as the correctness oracle.

runtime_json_write_policy.reason: PowerShell Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 can write BOM or corrupt ad-hoc pasted Chinese JSON in this workflow. Host visual/coach response backfill must be parsed and atomically written by Node before runtime ingestion.
applies_to: manual acceptance fixtures that feed runtime tools
runtime_json_write_policy.hard_rule: Any host CLI agent response JSON that will be consumed by runtime tools must be written through tools/write-jcc-host-agent-json.mjs or an equivalent Node fs.writeFile(..., 'utf8') no-BOM atomic writer. Do not use PowerShell Set-Content as the product backfill path.

lifecycle_contract.create: New high-value scorer output becomes an active advice_task.
lifecycle_contract.merge_update: Same trigger or same task updates the active task instead of creating noise.
lifecycle_contract.cooldown: Recent emitted trigger suppresses repeated advice.
lifecycle_contract.expiry: Active tasks expire after priority-based TTL unless updated.
lifecycle_contract.confirm: User confirmation removes the task and can return a task mode to cruise.
lifecycle_contract.skip: User skip removes the task and can return a task mode to cruise.
lifecycle_contract.cancel_response_task: The input-box square Stop cancels only the active host-model response/output task. It must not end match_session, clear live_state, disconnect MuMu, or erase the active device_connection. After cancellation, return to cruise or the current mode's idle state.
lifecycle_contract.user_message: User text is attached to active_task_context and should cause the current task to be reconsidered.
lifecycle_contract.mode_return: Explicit finish, confirm, or skip returns temporary task modes to cruise.

cruise.meaning: Always listen and only speak when the interrupt gate accepts a valuable advice_task.

active_season_choice_modes.visible_mode_policy: Use the descriptor runtime_ui_mode and renderer metadata only while that major season is active.
active_season_choice_modes.flow: One current-match user report opens one choice answer owner. Explicit confirmation updates the declared season fact and returns to cruise without creating a sibling answer.
active_season_choice_modes.major_season_migration: Replace the season descriptor; do not add season mode names to this common contract.

field_shape.source: mumu_bridge | host_multimodal_visual | economy_small_roi_interim | user_confirmed | user_triggered_snapshot | runtime_context | inferred | legacy_debug_ocr | legacy_debug_icon_matcher

state_confidence_contract.hard_rule: Low-confidence fields may change wording or ask for confirmation, but must not drive high-urgency advice alone.

debug_replay_policy.frame_policy: Screenshots/PNG frames are transient inputs only. Host multimodal visual sensing must delete them after structured fields are produced unless an explicit debug/calibration retain flag is used.
allowed_fields: live_state summary counts and small samples
debug_replay_policy.purpose: Debug why a coach suggestion appeared without retaining high-volume or sensitive gameplay artifacts.
